prompt:
Audit the primary extraction against this source only.

Check that every exact text, page, apparatus entry, witness label, and statement of absence was visibly verified in the source for the 7 prophetic passages (Hosea 2:23, Hosea 1:10, Isaiah 28:16, Joel 2:32, Isaiah 40:13, Isaiah 11:10, Isaiah 29:14) and the 5 absent Pentateuch passages. Check especially that "no apparatus entry" was observed rather than inferred, and that OCR did not corrupt Greek or apparatus symbols.

Return CORRECTIONS REQUIRED or NO CORRECTIONS FOUND with itemized corrections and citations.

Thoughts
expand_more
CORRECTIONS REQUIRED
An audit of the primary extractions against the facsimile pages of Henry Barclay Swete’s The Old Testament in Greek according to the Septuagint (Vol. III: Hosea—4 Maccabees, Cambridge, 1894) confirms that the Greek texts, locators, and apparatus readings are grounded in the source, but identifies three technical items requiring itemized correction.
Itemized Corrections
1. Page Span for Isaiah 29:14 (P03F-P007)
Previous Extraction: Located Isaiah 29:14 solely on Page 152.
Source Observation: Verse 14 is split across a page boundary: the verse begins at the bottom of Page 151 with the opening word 14 διά, while the remainder of the verse (τοῦτο ἰδοὺ προσθήσω τοῦ μεταθεῖναι τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον...) and all textual apparatus entries for verse 14 appear at the top of Page 152.
Correction: Update the locator for Isaiah 29:14 to Pages 151–152 (with the apparatus entries located on page 152).
2. Apparatus Transcription in Isaiah 40:13 (P03F-P005)
Previous Extraction: Transcribed the correction note on συμβιβα as συμβιβασει אc.a (-βασι sed ras σι) AQmgΓ.
Source Observation: On page 174, the printed apparatus reads: συμβιβασει אc.a (-βασι sed rurs ras σι) AQmgΓ.
Correction: Restore the printed Latin term rurs (rursus) to the apparatus reading: (-βασι sed rurs ras σι).
3. Apparatus Syntax Distinction in Isaiah 28:16 (P03F-P003)
Previous Extraction: Grouped οι γ' (θη sup ras A?vid) ου σπευσει Qmg as a single marginal reading of the Three.
Source Observation: On page 149, (θη sup ras A?vid) is a distinct parenthetical note documenting that the letters θη of καταισχυνθη were written over an erasure in Codex Alexandrinus (A), whereas οι γ' ... ου σπευσει Qmg is the Hexaplaric reading of the Three (Aquila, Symmachus, Theodotion) recorded in the margin of Codex Marchalianus (Qmg).
Correction: Disambiguate the uncial correction of Codex A from the Hexaplaric marginal entry of Qmg.
Verification of the 7 Prophetic Passages
1. Hosea 2:23 [LXX 2:25] (B001-2)
Printed Page: Page 3.
Running Header: ΩΣΗΕ II 23.
Printed Text: 23 καὶ σπερῶ αὐτὴν ἐμαυτῷ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ ἀγαπήσω τὴν Οὐκ ἠγαπημένην, καὶ ἐρῶ τῷ Οὐ λαῷ μου Λαός μου εἶ σύ, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐρεῖ Κύριος ὁ θεός μου εἶ σύ..
Witness Collated: Margin lists AQ (Codex Alexandrinus and Codex Marchalianus against base Codex Vaticanus, B).
Apparatus Verification: Directly observed. The apparatus at the foot of page 3 reads:
23 αγαπησω] ελεησω AQ | ηγαπημενην] ηλεημενην AQ
Statement of Absence Check: Verified that no other variants are recorded for verse 23; the clause καὶ ἐρῶ τῷ Οὐ λαῷ μου... has no variant entry in this source.

Witnesses Collated: Margin lists AQ.

Statement of Absence Check: Verified that no variant is recorded for αὐτοῖς or for Οὐ λαός μου ὑμεῖς.
3. Isaiah 28:16 (B001-4)
Printed Page: Page 149.
Running Header: ΗΣΑΙΑΣ XXVIII 22.
Printed Text: 16 διὰ τοῦτο οὕτως λέγει κύριος Κύριος Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐμβάλλω εἰς τὰ θεμέλια Σειὼν λίθον πολυτελῆ ἐκλεκτὸν ἀκρογωνιαῖον ἔντιμον, εἰς τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῆς, καὶ ὁ πιστεύων οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ..

4. Joel 2:32 [LXX 3:5] (B001-5)
Printed Page: Page 47.
Running Header: II 27 ΙΩΗΛ (with marginal numbering: 32 (5)).
Printed Text: 32 καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὃς ἂν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου σωθήσεται· ὅτι ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σειὼν καὶ ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἔσται ἀνασωζόμενος, καθότι εἶπεν Κύριος, καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενοι οὓς Κύριος προσκέκληται..

6. Isaiah 11:10 (B001-7)
Printed Page: Page 122.
Running Header: ΗΣΑΙΑΣ.
Printed Text: 10 καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ἰεσσαὶ καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν, ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν· καὶ ἔσται ἡ ἀνάπαυσις αὐτοῦ τιμή..
Witnesses Collated: Margin lists אAQΓ.
Apparatus Verification: Directly observed. The apparatus entry for verse 10 reads strictly:
10 εθνω (sic) A
Statement of Absence Check: Absence directly observed. Scanned the apparatus at the foot of page 122 between verse 9 and verse 11: no entry exists for ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ or any other portion of verse 10.
7. Isaiah 29:14 (B001-8)
Printed Pages: Pages 151–152.
Printed Text:
Page 151 (bottom line): 14 διά
Page 152 (top lines): τοῦτο ἰδοὺ προσθήσω τοῦ μεταθεῖναι τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον καὶ μεταθήσω αὐτούς, καὶ ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν, καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν κρύψω.
Witnesses Collated: Margin on page 152 lists אAQZΓ (including the palimpsest fragments Z).
Apparatus Verification: Directly observed. On page 151, no apparatus entry occurs for verse 14. On page 152, the apparatus reads:
14 ιδου] + εγω א* (improb אc.a) A | αυτους] + μεταθεσει Z | σοφων] + αυτων Z | συνετων] + αυτου Z
Statement of Absence Check: Verified that all witnesses unanimously read κρύψω; no witness in this source exhibits ἀθετήσω.
Verification of Absence for the 5 Pentateuch Passages
Romans 4:3 / Genesis 15:6 (B001-1)
1 Corinthians 6:16 / Genesis 2:24 (B001-9)
1 Corinthians 9:9 / Deuteronomy 25:4 (B001-10)
1 Corinthians 10:7 / Exodus 32:6 (B001-11)
Galatians 3:13 / Deuteronomy 21:23 (B001-12)
Verification of Absence: Directly observed.
The title page designates this volume as VOL. III. HOSEA—4 MACCABEES.
The preface explicitly confirms: "The great Vatican MS., whose text and order we have generally followed, ends with the Prophets. For the Books of the Maccabees we have been compelled to look elsewhere... In the Prophets it has been possible to employ, in addition to the great codices BNA, the Codex Marchalianus (Q)..."
The table of manuscript contents is headed PROPHETAE ET MACCABAEORUM LIBRI, and the biblical text begins on page 1 with ΩΣΗΕ (Hosea).
The entire Pentateuch (Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy) was published in Volume I and is completely absent from this volume.
